purpose_context: The doctrine pack and its governance relationship graph (DRG) are hard to discover: new projects have no single onboarding path, and the dashboard shows only the org-layer pack with no view of how artifacts relate or how they sit alongside spec-kitty built-ins. This mission makes the pack discoverable for humans (an onboarding guide authored as a worked example of the user-guide convention) and in the UI (an interactive, progressively-expanding DRG graph visualizer and visibility of spec-kitty built-in artifacts alongside the org-layer pack).
purpose_tldr: A user-guide-convention onboarding guide plus an interactive DRG graph visualizer and built-in doctrine visibility in the dashboard
